chunks.heading: THINKBIG at a glance
chunks.text: THINKBIG is a preschool and Montessori school management platform that connects school owners, teachers and families. Tagline: "Big Ideas. Brighter Futures." The website pages are: Home (index.html), Features (features.html), Pricing (pricing.html), Day Care (daycare.html), Pre Schools (preschools.html), Montessori (montessori.html), Multisite Centers (multisite.html), What's New (whats-new.html), Privacy Policy (privacy.html) and Terms of Service (terms.html). Prices are not published. Pricing is tailored to each program's size and number of locations, and the team prepares a personal quote. The pricing page asks a few questions to request one. Example plan structure on the site (prices to be confirmed): Starter (For a single preschool or day care getting started.); Growth (For schools with several classrooms and programs.); Multi-location (For groups running two or more centers.). To book a demo or request a quote, visitors use the demo request form on the home page (index.html#demo) or the questionnaire on the pricing page (pricing.html). Every "Get a Demo" button leads there. The website request forms currently run in preview mode: they check the answers but do not send them to the THINKBIG team yet. Say so if a visitor asks whether their request was received. No public email address or phone number is published on the website yet. The office address is in the website footer. The THINKBIG mobile apps for the App Store and Google Play are marked "Coming soon". Online login is not available on the website yet. Customer testimonials are not published yet; the site shows THINKBIG principles instead until customer stories are verified.

chunks.heading: What is THINKBIG?
chunks.text: What is THINKBIG? THINKBIG is a preschool and Montessori school management platform. It brings attendance, family communication, billing, admissions, classroom tools and child development records into one place.

chunks.heading: Who can use the platform?
chunks.text: Who can use the platform? THINKBIG is designed for school owners and administrators, teachers and staff, and the parents and guardians of enrolled children. Each group sees the tools relevant to their role.

chunks.heading: Does it support Montessori schools?
chunks.text: Does it support Montessori schools? Yes. Observations can be organized across Montessori areas such as Practical Life, Sensorial, Language, Mathematics and Cultural Studies, helping teachers follow each child's progress at their own pace.

chunks.heading: Can parents receive daily updates?
chunks.text: Can parents receive daily updates? Yes. Families can see attendance, meals, naps, activities, photos, announcements and milestones shared by their child's school.

chunks.heading: Can THINKBIG support multiple locations?
chunks.text: Can THINKBIG support multiple locations? Yes. Groups with more than one center can switch between locations or view combined information from a single dashboard.

chunks.heading: How can I request a demo?
chunks.text: How can I request a demo? Use the demo request form on this page. Tell us a little about your school and we'll arrange a walkthrough.

chunks.heading: How is children's information handled?
chunks.text: How is children's information handled? We take children's information seriously. During your demo we'll explain how information is stored, who can access it and how your school stays in control, and we're happy to answer detailed questions from your team.

chunks.heading: What is Montessori school software?
chunks.text: What is Montessori school software? It is one app for observations, lesson planning, family sharing and school administration, designed around Montessori classrooms.

chunks.heading: Does THINKBIG support the Montessori learning areas?
chunks.text: Does THINKBIG support the Montessori learning areas? Yes. Observations can be organized across Practical Life, Sensorial, Language, Mathematics and Cultural Studies.

chunks.heading: Does THINKBIG rank or compare children?
chunks.text: Does THINKBIG rank or compare children? No. Progress is shown as each child’s own journey, with gentle stages rather than scores or comparisons.

chunks.heading: Can families see their child’s progress?
chunks.text: Can families see their child’s progress? Yes. Guides choose which observations, photos and milestones to share with families.

chunks.heading: Can I manage fees and admissions too?
chunks.text: Can I manage fees and admissions too? Yes. Billing, enrollment, attendance and records live in the same platform as your observations.

chunks.heading: How is children’s information handled?
chunks.text: How is children’s information handled? We take children’s information seriously. During your demo we explain how information is stored, who can access it and how your school stays in control.

chunks.heading: Make observations part of your daily rhythm
chunks.text: Montessori guide Make observations part of your daily rhythm Ideas for keeping observation simple and meaningful: • Choose a few children to observe closely each day • Note what the child did, not just whether it was “mastered” • Add a next step while the moment is fresh • Use THINKBIG to keep observations by area and share them with families Talk to our team

chunks.heading: What key features does THINKBIG offer for multisite centers?
chunks.text: What key features does THINKBIG offer for multisite centers? A multi-location dashboard, group-wide reports, shared settings and fee plans, and access by role and location. Each center also gets the full set of THINKBIG tools: attendance, billing, admissions, staff schedules, family communication and learning records. See every feature.

chunks.heading: What are the benefits of running several centers with THINKBIG?
chunks.text: What are the benefits of running several centers with THINKBIG? You see what is happening at every location without collecting spreadsheets, fee plans and forms stay the same everywhere, and families get the same friendly app whichever center their child attends.

chunks.heading: How can I switch between locations easily?
chunks.text: How can I switch between locations easily? From one login you can switch between your centers or view combined information for the whole group.

chunks.heading: Does THINKBIG offer user roles and permissions?
chunks.text: Does THINKBIG offer user roles and permissions? Yes. Access can be set by role and location, so directors, center managers and teachers each see what is relevant to them.

chunks.heading: Can I run reports across all my locations at once?
chunks.text: Can I run reports across all my locations at once? Yes. Group-wide reports let you compare your centers and spot what needs attention, alongside attendance reports by day or month and a monthly income and spending view.

chunks.heading: How is my centers’ and families’ information handled?
chunks.text: How is my centers’ and families’ information handled? We take children’s information seriously. During your demo we explain how information is stored, who can access it and how your group stays in control. You can also read our privacy policy.
